questions: How many ways does create_shadow_issue.load_marker fail on a bad marker?
Is the no-raw-diagnostics contract asserted at any surface it names?

findings.finding: three failure modes, not one: truncated raises JSONDecodeError, non-UTF8 raises UnicodeDecodeError, and non-dict JSON returns a list with no error at all
the GH #429 remedy does not transfer: this loader's absent case already exits, so there is no established degraded value, and its caller is not a gate-writing path
findings.evidence: load_marker raises SystemExit when the marker is missing

findings.finding: the CLI test asserts only returncode; stdout appears solely inside assertion messages, so the contract holds by construction at all three named surfaces
